propos.visitor: You are reading Guide Négo without reserved access. The three agendas, the glossary, the FAQ and the public documents stay open.
propos.pending: Your request has reached IFDD. The answer will come by email; you can close the app, nothing is lost.
propos.granted: The reserved modules are open on this account, on all your devices.
propos.rejected: Your request was not granted. If you belong to a francophone network, ask it for the current code: it opens the modules right away.
propos.revoked: IFDD has revoked your access to the reserved modules. The rest of Guide Négo stays open.

reseaux.aide: Your membership comes from the code you entered. It opens nothing more at this stage: it will serve the reserved channels.
